title: Aqua Voice vs. superwhisper Guide | Willow October 2026
summary: Choosing between Aqua Voice and superwhisper in October 2026? We compare speed, accuracy, privacy, and pricing to help you decide.
body_markdown:
Cloud processing versus local-first. A fixed dictionary cap versus model-selection trade-offs. In the[Aqua Voice vs superwhisper](https://willowvoice.com/) decision, neither tool makes the choice obvious, but a look at latency, accuracy, and compliance makes it clearer.


**Willow Voice is the better pick than Aqua Voice or superwhisper for professionals who want fast, accurate dictation on Mac, Windows, and iOS.** In our September 2026 internal benchmarks, Willow Voice held 190 to 230ms at every dictation length, while Aqua Voice ran 550 to 800ms and superwhisper ran 480 to 900ms, and Willow Voice delivers 98%+ accuracy. Aqua Voice suits solo developers, and superwhisper suits individual power users who want local-first control.


**TLDR:**


-


Aqua Voice runs cloud-only at 550ms+ latency, while superwhisper runs local-first at 480ms+ with accuracy tied to the model picked.


-


Aqua Voice reports 97.4% on its own AISpeak-10 key-term benchmark, while superwhisper publishes word error rates for its models from its own benchmark suite.


-


Aqua Voice holds SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, but zero data retention and shared dictionaries sit on its $19/seat Business plan.


-


Both tools ship iOS voice keyboards, and neither offers zero data retention on every plan tier.


-


A third hybrid cloud and local dictation tool, covered later, holds ~200ms latency, 98%+ accuracy, and compliance on every plan tier.


## What Is Aqua Voice?


Aqua Voice (withaqua.com) is a cloud-based AI dictation tool built for developers and technical users. Its core engine, the Avalon transcription model, is tuned for coding vocabulary, so terms like function names and API references land cleanly. For a deeper look, see the[Willow Voice vs Aqua Voice comparison](https://willowvoice.com/comparison/aquavoice) .


It adjusts tone based on the active application, accepts natural language voice editing commands such as "delete the last sentence," supports a custom dictionary, and streams text in as you speak.


Aqua Voice runs on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, but offers no offline mode, so latency and accuracy depend on your connection.


## What Is superwhisper?


superwhisper is a local-first dictation tool built around on-device model processing, running on Apple Silicon on Mac and through the GPU on Windows, without touching a cloud server by default. Optional cloud models, including its own S1-Voice model and several third-party options, are available for higher accuracy. Its Modes system pairs a transcription model with a custom prompt and a per-app auto-activation rule, so speaking into Notion can behave differently than speaking into a terminal.


superwhisper runs on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, and offers a lifetime license at $249.99 alongside standard subscriptions. See the full[Willow Voice vs superwhisper comparison](https://willowvoice.com/comparison/superwhisper) for a detailed breakdown. It is built mainly for individual power users who value configurability and local privacy, with a separate seat-based Enterprise plan for teams that adds centralized billing, SSO, MDM deployment, and org-wide configuration.

## Latency and Real-Time Responsiveness


Latency is where the workflow difference becomes concrete. When you finish a sentence and wait for text to appear, that gap interrupts the next thought. Willow Voice holds at approximately 200ms regardless of how long you speak, with a ceiling of 230ms on even a five-minute session. Per-length figures for every consumer tool tested are in the[latency benchmark results](https://willowvoice.com/blog/dictation-accuracy-zero-edit-rate-benchmark) .


In our internal September 2026 benchmarks, Aqua Voice starts at around 550ms on short dictations and climbs to approximately 800ms on longer ones. superwhisper opens at around 480ms and averages roughly 700ms, with results tied to model and hardware.

## Accuracy and Vocabulary Recognition


Aqua Voice reports a[97.4% score on its own AISpeak-10 benchmark](https://aquavoice.com/vs/willow) , a key-term test it designed itself that measures technical-term recognition rather than overall transcript accuracy, and its Pro plan includes an expanded custom dictionary. It also claims the #1 spot among proprietary systems on the independent OpenASR leaderboard at its October 2025 debut. superwhisper does publish accuracy data in the form of word error rates from its own benchmark suite, for example 6.6% for its S1-Voice cloud model and 8.4% for the local Cohere Transcribe model. Results depend on which model you pick: smaller local Whisper models run faster with lower accuracy, larger local models are more accurate but slower, and cloud models need the Pro plan, a tradeoff[superwhisper's model documentation](https://superwhisper.com/docs/models/voice) lays out in detail. Willow Voice delivers 98%+ accuracy with no model selection to manage, and its Auto-Dictionary learns vocabulary continuously.


## Privacy Architecture and Compliance


Aqua Voice is cloud-only, and transcripts are retained by default to improve the model, with a Privacy Mode available to opt out. The company holds a SOC 2 Type II audit report, carries ISO 27001 certification, and states it is GDPR and HIPAA compliant. See our[voice dictation privacy and data security](https://willowvoice.com/blog/voice-dictation-security-privacy-guide) guide for more. Zero Data Retention sits on the Business plan at $19 per seat per month billed annually, and BAA terms should be confirmed directly with the vendor before handling protected health information.


superwhisper's local-first mode keeps audio on-device, but recordings are saved to disk by default. superwhisper makes its SOC 2 report available through its Trust Center under NDA, healthcare customers can sign a BAA, and local-only setups send no audio off the device. See[superwhisper's compliance documentation](https://superwhisper.com/docs/security/compliance) for details.


## Platform and Mobile Experience


Aqua Voice now has an iOS app. superwhisper ships both iOS and Android apps, with one Pro license covering every device. For a broader look at[best voice dictation software for Mac](https://willowvoice.com/blog/best-voice-dictation-software-mac) , see our September 2026 roundup.


Willow Voice on iOS is a custom voice keyboard that works inside any app already open on your phone, so you can speak directly into Slack, Gmail, or ChatGPT without switching apps. Willow Scribe is also available on iOS, with Draft mode for generating messages from a spoken prompt and Edit mode for rewriting selected text by voice. Custom vocabulary syncs across Mac, Windows, and iOS without per-device setup, so terms learned on desktop carry over to mobile automatically.


## Team Features and Enterprise Readiness


Aqua Voice's team offering is its Business plan, priced at $19 per seat per month billed annually ($24 billed monthly, two-seat minimum), with centralized billing, SSO/SAML and SCIM, Zero Data Retention, team-wide dictionaries, and Advanced Reporting for adoption and time-saved data.


superwhisper sells a separate seat-based Enterprise plan with centralized billing, SAML SSO, silent MDM deployment through Jamf or Intune, org-wide configuration pushes, and optional usage analytics, a different structure an engineering lead or IT team should weigh when assessing[voice dictation for enterprise teams](https://willowvoice.com/blog/best-voice-dictation-for-enterprise-teams) .


Willow Voice gives teams shared custom dictionaries, admin controls that push vocabulary changes org-wide from a single dashboard, and team leaderboards showing words transcribed and time saved per person. Codebase auto-tagging in Cursor or Windsurf reads open project files and learns class names, function names, and variable references from the first session. SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and zero data retention apply across all plan tiers, including free.


## Pricing and Free Tier Accessibility


Aqua Voice's free plan includes 1,000 free words, more of a trial than an ongoing option. Pro runs $8 per month billed annually or $10 per month month-to-month, Max runs $24 per month billed annually ($30 monthly) and adds Realtime Mode plus a 'Send it' voice command, and[Aqua Voice's pricing page](https://aquavoice.com/pricing) lists Business at $19 per seat per month billed annually ($24 monthly, two-seat minimum).


superwhisper's free tier allows unlimited dictation with any local Whisper model and custom vocabulary. Pro adds cloud models and file transcription, priced at $8.49 per month, $84.99 per year, or the $249.99 lifetime license. Team pricing runs through a separate Enterprise plan.


Willow Voice's free plan gives unlimited dictation with no credit card required. Individual is $12 per month billed annually with unlimited Willow Scribe. Team is $10 per user per month billed annually and adds shared dictionaries, admin controls, and leaderboards. SOC 2 Type II and zero data retention apply on every tier. See the full list of[best dictation software tools](https://willowvoice.com/blog/best-dictation-software-tools) for more options.


## What Changed for Both Tools in October 2026


Both vendors keep changing plans and models, so check current details before you commit. On the Aqua Voice side, the app now ships on Android through Google Play alongside Mac, Windows, and iOS, and the Max plan adds Realtime Mode, which shows words live as you speak. Students get 70% off Pro and Max with a school email, according to[Aqua Voice's plan details](https://aquavoice.com/pricing) .


On the superwhisper side, its voice model list names Cohere Transcribe as its most accurate local model, at an 8.4% word error rate on Apple M4. It runs on the GPU on Mac and Windows, but not on Windows ARM, where Parakeet Multilanguage (24 languages) is the only local option.


## Which Fits Your Workflow: Aqua Voice or superwhisper?


The right pick depends on whether a reliable connection and coding vocabulary matter more to you, or whether local control and model choice matter more.


### Choose Aqua Voice if...


Aqua Voice's Avalon model is tuned for coding vocabulary, it accepts natural language voice editing commands, its tone adapts per app, and it runs on Android alongside Mac, Windows, and iOS. The tradeoffs are cloud-only processing at 550ms+ latency and a free plan limited to 1,000 words. It suits solo developers who dictate into technical tools on a reliable connection.


### Choose superwhisper if...


superwhisper runs local-first with a choice of models, its Modes system pairs a prompt and per-app activation rule, the free tier allows unlimited dictation with local models, and a $249.99 lifetime license avoids recurring fees. The tradeoffs are latency that ranges from about 480ms to 900ms depending on model and hardware, recordings saved to disk by default, and no shared team dictionaries documented. It suits individual power users who want configurability and on-device privacy.


## Why Willow Voice Is the Better Choice for Professionals


Speaking at 150 WPM versus typing at 40 WPM removes a major bottleneck. Latency that grows with session length puts it back, and Willow Voice stays at roughly 200ms across every dictation length.


### Personalization That Adapts Without Configuration


Willow's Auto-Dictionary learns names, technical terms, and contacts automatically, so there is no manual entry to maintain. In Cursor and Windsurf, codebase auto-tagging reads open project files and learns class names, function names, and variable references from the first session.


### Built for Teams from Day One


Willow's $10 per user per month Team plan includes leaderboards that give leads adoption visibility, admin controls that push vocabulary changes org-wide, and cross-device vocabulary sync as standard.


### Enterprise-Grade Compliance at Every Plan Tier


Willow's SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA compliance, and zero data retention apply at every plan tier, including free, with a signed BAA available at Enterprise.


## FAQs


### Is Aqua Voice better than superwhisper for technical vocabulary and coding workflows?


Aqua Voice's Avalon model handles developer vocabulary well, and AISpeak-10 is a benchmark Aqua designed itself that measures key-term recognition, though Aqua also reports ranking #1 among proprietary systems on the OpenASR leaderboard. superwhisper offers more model flexibility, but manual selection to balance speed against accuracy adds friction over a workday.


### How does superwhisper's pricing compare to Aqua Voice for individual users?


superwhisper offers a $249.99 lifetime license, a genuine long-term option for avoiding recurring costs. Aqua Voice's free plan includes 1,000 free words, which works more like a trial, with Pro starting at $8 per month billed annually ($10 month-to-month), so ongoing use needs a subscription almost immediately.


### Does Aqua Voice or superwhisper support team deployment and shared dictionaries?


Aqua Voice does, through its Business plan at $19 per seat per month billed annually, with team-wide dictionaries, SSO/SCIM, centralized billing, and Zero Data Retention. superwhisper offers a separate Enterprise plan with centralized billing, SSO, and MDM deployment, though no shared team dictionaries are documented.


### Which tool handles privacy better: Aqua Voice or superwhisper?


superwhisper keeps audio on-device in local mode but saves recordings to disk by default, and provides its SOC 2 report through its Trust Center along with a self-serve BAA. Aqua Voice is cloud-only but holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance, with Zero Data Retention on Business and a Privacy Mode that controls transcript storage; confirm BAA terms with the vendor.


## Final Thoughts on Aqua Voice vs. superwhisper


The[Aqua Voice vs. superwhisper](https://willowvoice.com/) choice splits along cloud simplicity versus local privacy control, and both tools carry latency and team limits worth weighing before you commit. If consistent speed, accuracy, and compliance across a full workday matter more than either tradeoff, download Willow Voice and try it directly.
